verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing says users can create custom automations with Rovo AI, including automated reminders and rules that move work forward. It also says automation keeps Jira up to date 'so you don't have to', which implies the rules run in the background without a person. The evidence is thin, marketing-level feature copy only, so it does not show how autonomous these background runs really are. missing for 10: documentation of triggers, schedules and recurring background execution, detail on how automation rules are configured and run, and independent or hands-on confirmation that automations run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
